t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 4 pairs of gnomes that stick together. Remember the colours as one of them will give you more points. When starting the round you use this to your advantage by going for that one. There is a strategy opportunity

vb_textbox.text: Keep these rules in mind - There are 4x pairs of gnomes that always appear together in a round- Using that information see which gnome in the pair gives you the most mushrooms.- If the mushroom quantity lowers straight away start going for other gnome.- The pairs reset when the round is overTips - Remember the colours rather than the gnome pairs if it's too fast - The time it takes for the basket to appear is constant so you can predict when to hit space- It's better to test and be wrong on 1x rather 5x multipliers
